digest.component_or_area: review_kernel Pass-2 verification telemetry shared between plan_review and code_review pipelines
propositions: The shared verify_findings() kernel is implemented and unit-tested but is not called by either live consumer pipeline, and cannot be as-is because both run Pass-2 as a declarative per-chunk workflow step rather than a procedural run_chunk loop.

Per-chunk outcome signals (empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) are not reconstructable at the merged *_decide boundary, so this ticket derives a whole-run tally instead and defers true per-chunk metadata as follow-on work.
code_review_decide only logs contract violations while plan_review_decide records them into a run-scoped ContextVar sink, so code-review violation data never reaches its verdict coverage.

Move the collect/record/drain contract-violation sink into review_kernel as one shared implementation imported by both pipelines, wiring code-review to activate it in gate_dispatch._run_code_review_gate and drain into finalize_code_review_verdict coverage.

Add a shared decide_outcome_counts helper computing a single-run clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable tally (unrecoverable always 0) and emit outcome_counts additively from both *_decide steps into verdict coverage.
Changes are purely additive observability with no change to decision thresholds, impact functions, or verdict shape, and existing plan-review and code-review tests must pass unmodified.
